competitor.name: Willis Towers Watson
competitor.description: Global advisory, broking, and solutions company providing data-driven, insight-led solutions across people, risk, and capital.

items.title: WTW Launches Neuron Digital Placement Engine for Excess Casualty
items.summary: Introduced Neuron Casualty, an algorithmic marketplace platform automating quote comparison and binder execution with top 10 excess casualty underwriters.

items.title: WTW Expands Aviation and Aerospace Broking Practice Leadership
items.summary: Appointed Marcus Vance as North American Aviation Practice Leader to capture growing unmanned aerial systems and commercial space launch risks.

items.title: WTW Commercial Lines Insurance Pricing Survey Notes Rate Moderation
items.summary: WTW CLIPS index showed aggregate commercial line prices rose by 4.1%, with workers' compensation continuing multi-year rate reductions.

items.title: WTW Acquires Financial Lines Managing General Agency Verus Specialty
items.summary: Acquired boutique underwriting agency Verus Specialty to strengthen cyber, transactional liability, and professional indemnity underwriting.

items.title: WTW Closes Deal for Pension & Executive Benefits Consultancy
items.summary: Broadened human capital advisory operations by acquiring New England corporate retirement advisory firm.

battlecard_template.headline: Digital Broking Platform Neuron Drives Complex Placement Differentiation
battlecard_template.subtext: WTW continues heavy investment in Neuron algorithmic placement platforms while reinforcing specialty practices across human capital and financial lines.

wins.title: Holistic Relationship Over Algorithmic Matching
wins.text: Frame WTW's automated Neuron platform as cold carrier syndication versus our consultative underwriter negotiation.

wins.title: Middle-Market Commercial P&C Focus
wins.text: Target mid-sized commercial accounts where WTW's focus leans disproportionately toward large institutional corporate risk.

wins.title: Personalized Claims Advocacy
wins.text: Offer hands-on in-house claims advocacy specialists whereas WTW frequently utilizes offshore claims clearing desks for standard claims.

moves.summary: Introduced Neuron Casualty algorithmic platform connecting underwriters for excess commercial lines.
Hired Marcus Vance to lead North American aviation and aerospace practice.
Acquired boutique underwriting agency Verus Specialty for financial lines coverage.
